chars.SAID: SAID: a tidy Moroccan man in his early 30s, short neat black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a crisp light-blue button-up shirt tucked into dark navy chinos, brown leather belt, silver wristwatch.
chars.FATIMA: FATIMA: a Moroccan woman in her late 50s, slightly plump, wearing a mustard-yellow headscarf, a long dark-green house djellaba with white trim, a faded red apron tied at the waist, plastic slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a clean bright Moroccan living room with low sofas and zellige details, in a quiet house on the outskirts of Casablanca. SAID sits on the sofa staring at his smartphone screen with a suspicious, shocked frown, while behind him FATIMA, sweeping the floor with a broom, glances at him sideways with a nervous guilty look. Tension between them. Phone screen is glowing, no readable content.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room seen from a high corner like a security camera, slightly grainy. FATIMA leans out of the open window, whispering secretly to someone outside who cannot be seen, hand cupped near her mouth, looking left and right.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SAID alone at night in his bedroom, sitting on the edge of the bed, holding the phone close to his face, frustrated, tapping the screen, trying to hear something, puzzled expression. Dim lamp light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Entrance hall of a Moroccan house. FATIMA quietly sneaking out through the front wooden door, opening it carefully, looking back over her shoulder to make sure nobody sees her, tiptoeing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same entrance hall. FATIMA coming back inside through the front door, slightly out of breath, quickly fixing her headscarf and smoothing her djellaba, with a secretive, satisfied look.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SAID standing in front of his house's front door which is left half open, holding his phone in one hand, his other hand on his forehead, eyes wide with realisation and anger. Quiet empty street behind.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the Moroccan kitchen. SAID, serious and angry, holds his phone out toward FATIMA showing her the screen. FATIMA stands frozen, silent, head lowered, hands clasped on her apron, avoiding his eyes.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same kitchen. FATIMA looks up at SAID with terrified eyes, trembling, hands shaking, about to confess a dark secret, speaking in a low voice. SAID leans back, surprised.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of SAID in the kitchen, his face pale and scared, eyes wide, swallowing hard, goosebumps, as if he just heard something frightening. Background slightly dark, the hallway behind him dark and empty.
